Hi Jared — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery + clear next steps so we stay aligned.

Call highlights (summary):
- Primary use case: document summarization + internal knowledge assistant for customer support (initial scope: 2M pages / month).
- Decision criteria: latency SLO (~<200ms p50 for routing questions), unit cost, single-tenant/private deployment option, SOC 2 / audit log availability, model quality on legal/finance language.
- Likely stakeholders:
  - Economic buyer: Lisa Ortiz (CFO) — needs clear ROI and TCO comparison vs existing vendor
  - Security / Infosec: Tom Nguyen (Head of Security) — will require SOC 2 + encryption/TLS + KMS/HSM details
  - Procurement: Emma Park / procurement@finovatebank.com — standard vendor & contract questions
  - Technical champion: Jared Collins (you) and platform engs for POC & integration

Proposed next steps:
1) I will send a champion enablement packet (talk tracks, ROI worksheet, one-pager for Lisa) — attached.
2) Jared to introduce Procurement & Legal so we can confirm procurement timeline and MSA requirements.
3) Schedule a technical deep dive (Neha Kapoor will own) — suggested slot: Wed 2027-07-07 10:00 ET.
4) Provide procurement with our standard MSA + pricing summary (we can do a short SOW for the POC).

Attachments: champion-playbook.pdf (champion talking points + one-pager), ROI-worksheet.xlsx (simple TCO model).

If this looks accurate please reply with any missing stakeholders or if we should add anyone to the tech deep dive. Thanks again — excited to get this moving.

Best,

Marissa / Rachel — quick internal note to prep the champion enablement packet before we send to Lisa / Jared's execs. Suggested talk tracks + bullets below (short & skimmable for an exec):

Talk tracks for Lisa Ortiz (CFO) — 1-page summary:
- Cost avoidance: estimated 30-40% lower per-token/unit cost vs incumbent with batching + caching; ROI worksheet attached shows 9-month payback for 2M pages/month POC.
- Predictable spend: dedicated capacity option with committed throughput and predictable monthly pricing for enterprise.
- Risk & compliance: SOC 2 Type II, KMS integration, audit logs; Redwood Private (VPC) available for regulated workloads.

Technical talking points for Tom Nguyen (Head of Security):
- Data controls: customer-managed KMS, optional on-prem connectors, retention windows, and field-level redaction support.
- Observability: per-request tracing and token-level cost breakdown for audits.

Suggested next steps for champion (Jared):
- Send intro email to Lisa + Procurement + Legal (Jared said he'll do this).
- Share our one-pager + ROI worksheet with Lisa; I can join a 20-minute call to walk through numbers.

I'll draft the one-pager and Marissa, I'll send the champion-playbook + ROI worksheet to Jared+Lisa after your sign-off. Want to sync 30m before Wed deep dive? I'm open 7/6 2-3pm PT.
